canonical.behaviour: Create the isolated worktree for this task: D:\workflow-axa-speed on a new branch speed/2.10 from main 1a0d523, so the live hooks in D:\workflow-axa stay untouched. Nothing else changes here. The task records are then copied into the worktree, and the session moves into it to present the offer for the actual work (tickets T0 to T8). That second offer is a separate approval, because an approval given in this checkout does not cover writes in another worktree.
exclusions: any change to hooks/, skills/, tests/ or tools/ in D:\workflow-axa
conditions: The worktree is created with one explicit command: git worktree add -b speed/2.10 D:/workflow-axa-speed 1a0d523
checks: git status in D:\workflow-axa is unchanged apart from this task's records
git worktree list shows D:/workflow-axa-speed on speed/2.10 at 1a0d523
